subject: Medford Life Science Park Proposal
overview: Combined Properties presented a proposal to redevelop approximately eight acres along Mystic Avenue into the Medford Life Science Park, featuring 1.2 million square feet of lab and office space across four buildings. The development team detailed the site plan, requested zoning overlay, traffic considerations, and stormwater mitigation before taking public questions.

items.title: Presentation: Medford Life Science Park
items.summary: Combined Properties presented plans for a 1.2-million-square-foot life science campus across four eight-story buildings on Mystic Avenue, requiring a Planned Commercial Development District zoning overlay.

items.title: Public Q&A
items.summary: The development team addressed submitted questions regarding Winterbrook maintenance, retail spaces, ground-breaking timelines, flooding mitigation, street safety along Mystic Avenue, and community benefits.
